step: Chip on Wafer (CoW) process
singulate the CoW module
traditional flip chip (FC) assembly of module to package substrate
attach lid via TIM and lid foot adhesive
notes: Stated as package design element; order not given.

step: provide standard <100> 4 inch Si wafer as substrate core
locator: p.3 Sec. III; p.4 Sec. III.C; p.2 Fig. 1

step: laminate ABF GL-102 on both sides of the wafer
cure ABF GL-102
extended thermal soak under vacuum to degas ABF before deposition
ICPCVD Si3N4 passivation layer
locator: p.3 Sec. III; p.4 Sec. III.B; p.4 Fig. 4
notes: Fig. 1 labels the deposition HDPCVD; text ICPCVD.

step: ICPCVD SiO2 bulk dielectric
locator: p.3 Sec. III; p.4 Sec. III.B; p.4 Fig. 3(a)

step: ICPCVD Si3N4 polish-stop layer
locator: p.3 Sec. III; p.4 Sec. III.B; p.4 Fig. 3(a)
notes: N-O-N stack drawn as 4 um in Fig. 1.

step: surface roughness and wafer warpage check before lithography
result: RMS roughness 20.308 nm; negligible warpage increase; no pre-litho CMP needed

step: spin AZ 5214 positive tone resist
hard-contact exposure of pillar pattern
hard bake resist as soft mask for RIE
fluorine RIE of nitride and oxide to open pillar holes
conditions: CHF3, C4F8, Ar; ~0.51 um/min; selective to resist and ABF

step: sputter Ti/Cu seed layer
Cu electroplating with overburden
Cu and Ti CMP stopping on Si3N4
blanket dielectric recess around pillars with same RIE
locator: p.4 Sec. III.C; p.2 Fig. 1; p.4 Fig. 4

step: place substrate on chuck; align die to fiducials and target region
conditions: chuck 120 C; nitrogen sheath around bond region; atmospheric pressure
locator: p.5 Sec. IV.A; p.5 Fig. 5(a); p.2 Fig. 1

step: in-situ formic acid vapor cleaning of die pads and substrate pillars
conditions: formic acid vapor in nitrogen sheath

step: solderless Cu-Cu thermocompression bonding of die to pillars
conditions: bond head 380 C; bond interface 250 C; chuck 120 C
locator: p.5 Sec. IV.A-B; p.5 Fig. 5(a); p.2 Fig. 1

step: provide glass panel
adhesion-promoting plasma and silane pretreatment of bare glass
laminate polymer dielectric on both sides (double-sided SAP)
cure polymer dielectric
sputter Ti adhesion layer and Cu seed layer
Cu electroplating of RDL
locator: p.3 Sec. II.C; p.2 Table I
notes: Order as written (plating, then lithography/patterning); 22 um = Table I RDL thickness.

step: photolithography and patterning to define RDLs
photoresist stripping
wet etch exposed Cu seed
dry etch underlying Ti
apply and pattern solder mask to expose BGA pads
apply OSP surface finish
locator: p.3 Sec. II.C; p.2 Table I

step: dice processed glass panel into substrates
apply epoxy adhesive to bottom of each xPU-like die and place on glass substrate top side
cure die adhesive in oven
build 10-layer HBM-like stacks: bond each 50 um die individually with the same adhesive
notes: Paper does not state whether stacking precedes or follows xPU attach; placed after.

step: final batch cure of HBM-like stacks
print SAC305 solder paste on substrate backside BGA pads
equipment: automatic screen printer (EKRA); stainless-steel laser-cut stencil

step: 3-D surface profiling of printed paste volume
reflow printed paste to form BGA balls
equipment: LPKF ProtoFlow S single zone reflow oven

step: print solder paste onto PCB pads
locator: p.3 Sec. II.E.3; p.4 Sec. II.E.3

step: manually align and place glass substrate package on printed PCB
board-level reflow soldering
equipment: LPKF ProtoFlow S single zone reflow oven

step: dispense corner-fill at four corners of glass substrate
cure corner-fill
X-ray inspection of solder joint voids and alignment
result: solder joints formed and aligned to PCB pads
